about.title: About Parker Russell Argentina
about.lead: Parker Russell Argentina, part of FI Argentina Group, is an independent professional services firm supporting Argentine and international businesses across tax, audit, accounting, legal and corporate matters.
about.body: With more than two decades of local experience, the firm combines multidisciplinary expertise with an international perspective, supporting clients with regulatory compliance, cross-border taxation, transactions, corporate structuring and wider business requirements.
